title_en: there was/were / there has/have been / there will be
title_vi: there was/were / there has/have been / there will be (đã có / sẽ có)
theory_html:
A. there was / there were (past)

A. there was / there were (quá khứ)

There is a train every hour. The time now is 11.15. There was a train at 11 o’clock.

Cứ mỗi giờ có một chuyến tàu. Bây giờ là 11 giờ 15. Lúc 11 giờ đã có một chuyến.

there is / are (present)
hiện tại		there was / were (past)
quá khứ
There is nothing on TV tonight.There was nothing on TV last night.
We are staying at a very big hotel. There are 550 rooms.We stayed at a very big hotel. There were 550 rooms.
Is everything OK? Are there any problems?Was everything OK yesterday? Were there any problems?
I’m hungry, but there isn’t anything to eat.I was hungry when I got home, but there wasn’t anything to eat.

B. there has been / there have been (present perfect)

B. there has been / there have been (hiện tại hoàn thành)

  • Look! There’s been an accident. (there’s been = there has been)

    Nhìn kìa! Có tai nạn rồi. (there’s been = there has been)

  • This road is very dangerous. There have been many accidents.

    Con đường này rất nguy hiểm. Đã có nhiều vụ tai nạn.

Compare there was (past):

So sánh there was (quá khứ):

  • There was an accident last night. (not There has been an accident last night.)

    Tối qua có một vụ tai nạn. (không nói There has been an accident last night.)

C. there will be

C. there will be (sẽ có)

  • Do you think there will be a lot of people at the party on Saturday?

    Bạn có nghĩ thứ Bảy sẽ có nhiều người đến bữa tiệc không?

  • The manager of the company is leaving, so there will be a new manager soon.

    Giám đốc công ty sắp nghỉ, nên chẳng bao lâu nữa sẽ có giám đốc mới.

  • I’m going away tomorrow. I’ll do my packing today because there won’t be time tomorrow. (there won’t be = there will not be)

    Mai tôi đi xa. Hôm nay tôi sẽ xếp đồ vì mai sẽ không có thời gian.

  • There will be rain tomorrow afternoon.

    Chiều mai sẽ có mưa.

mcq.question: There is a train every hour. The time now is 11.15. ___ a train at 11 o’clock.
mcq.full: There is a train every hour. The time now is 11.15. There was a train at 11 o’clock.

mcq.expl:
there was + singular / there were + plural (past); was there / were there …?; there wasn’t / weren’t.
there was + số ít / there were + số nhiều (quá khứ); was there / were there …?; there wasn’t / weren’t.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Quá khứ số ít → There was.
mcq.key: There is a train every hour. The time now is 11.15. ___ a train at 11 o’clock.|There was
